title: Phrases: tech calls
description: Frasi pronte per le call tecniche

cards.back: Sorry to jump in, but could I just add something?
cards.example: Sorry to jump in, but the partner bank changed the file format.

cards.back: Sorry, could you repeat the last part?
cards.example: Sorry, could you repeat the last part about the rollback?

cards.back: Sorry, you broke up there. Could you say that again?
cards.example: Sorry, you broke up there. Which environment did you mean?

cards.back: I think you're on mute.
cards.example: I think you're on mute, we can't hear you at all.

cards.back: Can everyone hear me OK?
cards.example: Can everyone hear me OK before we start the review?

cards.back: Let me share my screen.
cards.example: Let me share my screen and walk you through the logs.

cards.back: Can you see my screen?
cards.example: Can you see my screen with the deployment pipeline?

cards.front: Aspettiamo ancora un paio di minuti
cards.back: Let's give it a couple more minutes for others to join.
cards.example: Let's give it a couple more minutes for the PM to join.

cards.back: There are three things I'd like to cover today.
cards.example: There are three things I'd like to cover today, starting with the incident.

cards.back: We've only got half an hour, so let's keep it focused.
cards.example: We've only got half an hour, so let's keep it focused on the release.

cards.back: What exactly do you mean by...?
cards.example: What exactly do you mean by a partial reconciliation?

cards.back: So, if I understand correctly, ...
cards.example: So, if I understand correctly, the batch failed after midnight?

cards.back: If I could just finish my point...
cards.example: If I could just finish my point, then I'll hand over to you.

cards.back: Go ahead, please.
cards.example: Go ahead, please, you were about to mention the timeout.

cards.back: Sorry, we spoke over each other. You go first.
cards.example: Sorry, we spoke over each other. You go first this time.

cards.back: That's a good point.
cards.example: That's a good point, we hadn't considered the retry logic.

cards.back: I'm not sure I entirely agree.
cards.example: I'm not sure I entirely agree with moving the release forward.

cards.front: Capisco il tuo punto di vista, però...
cards.back: I see where you're coming from, but...
cards.example: I see where you're coming from, but the risk is too high.

cards.back: Let me check and get back to you.
cards.example: Let me check with the vendor and get back to you.

cards.front: Non lo so su due piedi
cards.back: I don't know off the top of my head.
cards.example: I don't know off the top of my head how many orders failed.

cards.back: Shall we take this offline?
cards.example: Shall we take this offline and focus on the release plan?

cards.back: Let's park that for now.
cards.example: Let's park that for now and come back to it on Friday.

cards.back: Let's get back on track.
cards.example: Let's get back on track and look at the open tickets.

cards.back: Where are we with...?
cards.example: Where are we with the signature integration?

cards.back: We're on track.
cards.example: We're on track to deliver the onboarding changes by Friday.

cards.back: We're running behind schedule.
cards.example: We're running behind schedule because the test environment was down.

cards.back: We're blocked on...
cards.example: We're blocked on the partner bank's new certificate.

cards.back: What's your take on this?
cards.example: What's your take on splitting the service in two?

cards.back: Does anyone else have anything to add?
cards.example: Does anyone else have anything to add before we move on?

cards.back: Let's move on to the next item.
cards.example: Let's move on to the next item: the KPI dashboard.

cards.back: Let me just recap the action points.
cards.example: Let me just recap the action points before we wrap up.

cards.back: Who's going to take this on?
cards.example: Who's going to take this on while the lead is away?

cards.back: I'll take care of it.
cards.example: I'll take care of it and update the ticket tonight.

cards.back: I'll send a follow-up email with the next steps.
cards.example: I'll send a follow-up email with the next steps after lunch.

cards.back: Let's wrap it up there.
cards.example: Let's wrap it up there, thanks for your time, everyone.

cards.back: Sorry, I have to drop off now.
cards.example: Sorry, I have to drop off now for another call.

cards.back: Thanks, everyone, for joining.
cards.example: Thanks, everyone, for joining at such short notice.

cards.front: Puoi parlare un po' più lentamente?
cards.back: Could you speak a bit more slowly, please?
cards.example: Could you speak a bit more slowly, please? The line isn't great.

cards.back: Could you spell that for me?
cards.example: Could you spell that for me? I want the exact error code.

cards.back: Just a quick question before we move on.
cards.example: Just a quick question before we move on: is this in production?
